attachment.snippet:
1	# MCPg v0.7.0 — release notes
2	
3	**Released:** 2026-08-01
4	**Tool surface:** **254** tools across 19 capability buckets (read-only
5	mode exposes a subset) — unchanged from 0.6.12; this release ships zero
6	tool additions or removals.
7	**Tests:** full unit + contract suite green locally on this branch. The
8	integration matrix (PG 14–18 required, PG 19 + WarehousePG experimental)
9	runs via `ci.yml` on push to `main`/`claude/**` or on an opened PR — not
10	yet exercised for this exact commit, since it hasn't been pushed.
11	**Runtime:** Python 3.12–3.14 (`requires-python >=3.12`; CI/mypy target
12	3.14)
13	
14	A **0.6.12 → 0.7.0** release: the `mcp` 2.0 SDK migration that was
15	capped off in 0.6.12 (`mcp[cli]<2`, PR #290) is now complete. This is a
16	**breaking** release for anyone pinned to `mcp` 1.x — see "Upgrade
17	impact" below before updating.
18	
19	## Migrated to the `mcp` 2.0 SDK
20	
21	Lifts the `mcp[cli]<2` interim cap. The upstream SDK's `2.0.0` renamed
22	`mcp.server.fastmcp.FastMCP` to `mcp.server.mcpserver.MCPServer` and
23	restructured the module tree around it, with no back-compat shim. MCPg
24	now depends on `mcp>=2.0.0` and its own server class,
25	`mcpg.server.AuditedFastMCP`, is renamed to `mcpg.server.AuditedMCPServer`
26	(also exported in `__all__`) to match — **no backward-compatibility
27	alias** is provided for the old name. Zero changes to any of the 254
28	tool registration call sites; the SDK's own HTTP entry point
29	(`streamable_http_app`/`sse_app`) moved its `host` argument off the
30	constructor, and MCPg's `http_runtime` module was updated to pass it at
31	call time instead. See `docs/plans/mcp-2.0-migration.md` for the full
32	migration rationale and task-by-task history.
33	
34	## Tenancy redesigned onto `ServerMiddleware`
35	
36	Per-request role propagation moved off the removed `request_ctx` ambient
37	contextvar hack onto a proper `ServerMiddleware`. This is a
38	simplification, not just a port: `current_role` is now reliably
39	authoritative on **every** transport (previously only guaranteed on
40	stdio), closing a gap where HTTP/SSE requests could see a stale or
41	default role under the old contextvar approach.
42	
43	## New: opt-in write confirmation via elicitation
44	
45	**`MCPG_ELICIT_CONFIRM_WRITES`** (default `false`): when set, every
46	write/DDL/shell/listen/migrate-tier tool call requires an accepted
47	`ctx.elicit()` confirmation before running, for MCP clients that declare
48	elicitation support. Centralized in `AuditedMCPServer.call_tool` — no
49	per-tool changes were needed to support it. Off by default; existing
50	deployments see no behaviour change unless they opt in.
51	
52	## Fixed: README "Listed On" rendering on the published docs site
53	
54	The GitHub Pages site (Jekyll + kramdown, built from `README.md`) was
55	rendering the "Glama" bullet in the "📍 Listed On" list as an oversized
56	`<h2>` heading instead of a plain bulleted link, while the same section
57	looked correct on GitHub.com. Root cause: the bullet list ended directly
58	against the `---` horizontal-rule divider with no blank line separating
59	them; GitHub's cmark renderer reads `---` after a list item as a
60	thematic break, but kramdown reads it as a Setext-heading underline for
61	the immediately preceding line when there's no blank line first. Fixed
62	by inserting the blank line. A repo-wide grep for the same precondition
63	(a non-blank line immediately followed by a bare `---`/`***`/`___`
64	line, excluding legitimate YAML front-matter closes) turned up no other
65	instances.
66	
67	## Upgrade impact
68	
69	- **Dependency floor moves to `mcp>=2.0.0`.** This is a hard break for
70	  any deployment pinned to `mcp` 1.x — the resolved `mcp` dependency no
71	  longer offers the 1.x `mcp.server.fastmcp.FastMCP` API. Upgrade `mcp`
72	  alongside MCPg; there is no dual-support window.
73	- **`mcpg.server.AuditedFastMCP` → `mcpg.server.AuditedMCPServer`**, with
74	  **no backward-compatibility alias**. If anything imports
75	  `AuditedFastMCP` directly (it was exported in `__all__`), update the
76	  import name to `AuditedMCPServer`.
77	- Tool behaviour, tool signatures, and the 254-tool surface are
78	  otherwise unchanged — this is an SDK/internals migration, not a
79	  tool-surface change.
80	
81	## Upgrade
82	
83	```bash
84	pip install --upgrade mcpg
85	docker pull ghcr.io/devopam/mcpg:0.7.0   # or :latest
86	```
87	
88	Or grab `mcpg-0.7.0.mcpb` from this release and double-click it into
89	Claude Desktop.
90	
91	## Full changelog
92	
93	See [`../CHANGELOG.md`](../CHANGELOG.md) `[0.7.0]` for the complete
94	itemised list.
